newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Linde deal, market sentiment push Richter to high.
newsitem.headline: Linde deal, market sentiment push Richter to high.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt firmed over four percent and reached a new high after Linde announced it has won a contract to build a new plant for Richter.
"The news of the plant gave a big boost to Richter's price," one trader said. "Foreigners are buying the paper heavily."
But traders said the rise was triggered only partially by the news and the market's overall positive sentiment had also contributed to Richter's increase.
"This news had a beneficial impact but the whole market is going upward," another trader said.
Richter shares opened at 11,500 forints, above Tuesday's close of 11,395, and surged to a new high of 11,950. At 1114 GMT they traded at 11,900 forints.
German engineering group Linde said earlier today it had won a contract to build a new 100 million mark pharmaceutical plant in Hungary for Richter.
